remarks:
Welcome to 240 Crisfield Ave.! This long-time family-owned home offers a great opportunity for a buyer looking to add their own personal touches.

The home features newer windows and a roof replaced in 2018 through a grant from the Town of Cheektowaga. The first floor offers two nice-sized bedrooms, a full bathroom, a spacious living room, and a kitchen that will need some updating.

The basement includes a wheelchair lift, finished recreation room, glass-block windows, a full handicap-accessible bathroom, and a laundry area. The older washer and dryer will remain with the property.

Outside, you'll find a large partially fenced yard with a shed, as well as a wheelchair ramp leading to the deck and rear entrance. The large covered front porch also features a wheelchair lift leading to the covered deck.

This property does need some TLC, but it provides an excellent opportunity for the new owner to make it their own.
SAM PUELO, ATTORNEY, 3659 HARLEM RD, BUFFALO, NY 14215

ESTATE SALE — PROPERTY BEING SOLD AS IS. The Estate is not in a position to make or pay for repairs resulting from a home inspection or appraisal.

Buyer is encouraged to perform their own due diligence and inspections.
